cases.description: HQ and Detail sent-message handoff excludes older loaded history on phone/iPad; shared renderer and desktop interfaces retain their read/send contracts
cases.setup: Mount actual HQConsoleView or DetailView with actual ChatView/useChatHistory and a controlled synthetic client. Recent ordinal200 differs, earlier ordinal199 has the repeated prompt and identical attachment identity. Defer send receipt, pagination and snapshots independently, with stable exact source record IDs.
cases.action: Load earlier then send the same text/image; also finish an in-flight older page after sending. Exercise accepted then true new source, rejected send, and receipt/snapshot ordering. Observe actual mounted user bubble identity and parent send payloads.
cases.expected: Exact T UI must fail target assertions: earlier records cannot consume or label the new pending bubble, failure leaves the old row unchanged, and only a true new recent occurrence hands off the same rendered bubble. The new source record is located by exact session/record identity, independently of prepended indices. Original stable sendID/target/attempt and attachment distinction tests remain unchanged; no dispatch or input outside the fixture.
